usedFor: Nimble Links makes short links with “Create short link”, plus special ones such as “Create Password-Protected Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “Create short link” in Nimble Links
bestTemplate.why: It shortens a URL into a shareable link, so messages carry a clean address.

watchOut: “Create Password-Protected Link” needs a password to reach the destination, so share it with the people who need it.
